fact: Chad has adopted a legal framework for cybersecurity, cybercrime and cyber defence: Ordinance No 007/PCMT/2022 of 31 August 2022 on cybercrime and cyber defence and Ordinance No 008/PCMT/2022 of 31 August 2022 on cybersecurity, replacing Law No 009/PR/2015.
title: CHAD: An Introduction to General Business Law
